name: BugHerd
description: Injects the third-party BugHerd feedback/bug-reporting sidebar into site pages, gated by role.
project_description:
BugHerd is an issue tracking system built for designers and web developers. This module allows you to quickly and easily add BugHerd to your Drupal site. The module allows you grant access to BugHerd by roles and even turn it off for admin pages. 

 Adding via this module instead of using the embed code on its own to your theme ensures

 
 That BugHerd can optionally appear in both the admin area and front-end theme 
 That you can decide which roles have access 
 That the logged in user (if any) is recorded as the submitter of the ticket 
 
 You can sign up for a free 14 day trial of BugHerd and see if it will work for you - no credit card needed. Check out the features list .
